correctness.rationale: For the repaired claim, compact-group Bochner theory gives nonnegative Fourier mass totaling 1. Evaluating on the order-two subgroup gives the exact two-negative character multiplier 5−2k−(−1)^h. Nonnegativity gives both shell-average constraints, and the fourteen slack values check the stated dual inequality for all parities without any symmetry assumption on f. An independent direct 128-character integer Walsh calculation gives minimum dual slack 0 and, for the proposed extremizer with weights in units of 1/56, total mass 56, minimum cube value 0, both shell sums zero, and quadratic numerator 96. Multiaffine interpolation extends all cube inequalities to cosine entries in [−1,1]; nonnegative cosine-product Fourier coefficients establish positive definiteness. Thus the attained value is 96/56=12/7, giving deficit −2/7. The prior comparison in the frozen RESULT.md line 107 was wrong: the prior kernel has value 9/35 on center–leaf pairs only and the leaf signs sum to 5, so the corrected quadratic value is 8−2(9/35)·5=38/7>2. This change does not alter the theorem or the conclusion about that witness. VERIFICATION.md and check_certificate.py were inspected, not executed.
